title: arc-report/1 (schema 1.1, Amendment A0)
description: The contract every RE-MEANING run emits: report.json, and verdicts.json (= report.verdicts_doc, $defs/VerdictsDoc). Schema 1.1 is arc-report/1 as amended by PREREG Amendment A0 (zero owner time): no owner-sourced field, I1 in its A0 form, I6, the just-in-time proxy vault, and the panel, provenance, contamination, witness and claude_plan_tokens blocks. Hashed into PREREG together with rules.yaml. Conventions: metrics are fractions in [0, 1]; a difference is arm_a - arm_b in the same unit; money is USD, time minutes, latency milliseconds, sizes bytes; hashes are lowercase hex sha256 (64 chars) except git SHAs (40 hex); timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC. null means 'not measured in this run' and is never coerced to 0.

adoption.description: Every nested adoption decision of this run, three per adopting rung; empty in measurement rungs.

collisions.description: R00, then whenever the person map changes.

panel.description: The proxy reader's sets generated in this run (R00: C_open and frontier C; read runs: the just-in-time vault set); null when the reader did not run.

provenance.description: R00: S1's git-blame provenance of every A sentence, B link item and inline link; null in later runs unless the corpus changes.

contamination.description: R00: the reader's exact-lookup (infini-gram) and continuation tests; null elsewhere.

witness.description: The Rekor / OpenTimestamps commitments this run made or relies on (VJ-2), in order.

fable.description: One record per orchestrator (Fable) call made in this run: R00 makes gold audit #1 and the sign-off; R10/R10K gold audit #2 and the two end-review passes. Empty when the run calls Fable not at all. Written by arcforge.fable (record).

branch.description: No other values; run-07's variants are branch 'N' plus h1_provisional.

h1Provisional.description: The latest governing H1 status; null before R05K/R06.

status.description: Verdict statuses. NOT_COMPUTABLE is never a status: an in-scope null fails the run.

arcStatus.description: NOT_TESTED is arc-level only: a registered rule no run of the realized branch path applied (H4 in S-F).

systemId.description: B0, B1, ship-lexical, B2, B2w, B3.<id>[@matched], B4 (= W0 at the champion's dims), B5 (= W1), B6.<id>, B7, ship-hybrid, champ, arm:<name>, and hyb(<any of those>).

stratumId.description: Query strata of ARC-Bench. C_vault is R10/R10K only; E_h only if the opt-in add-on runs. B.<name> are descriptive provenance restrictions of B (B.owner_authored, B.copilot_authored) that no rule reads; QUARANTINE[.<name>] holds the person-map-quarantined D-entity and E items, reported separately (A0 rule 6); C_frontier is the proxy reader's frontier set.

rowStratum.description: A VerdictRow's unit population: a query stratum, or a POOL.<name> of non-query items (POOL.remeaning: H3's labelled candidate pool; POOL.lexicon: H3b's lexemes; POOL.trace: H7's query-hit pairs).

prereg_sha256.description: null only before the R00 hash.

main_corpus_id.description: The S0- id through R08; equal to corpus_id from R09.

plan_ceiling_usd.description: 20 at r00 (the ceiling equals the cap), 17 later.

stage.description: A stage id of the M2 DAG (core/stages STAGE_ORDER), or the runner booking.

provider.description: orchestrator: Fable calls; claude_plan: the Claude reference leg, logged against the owner's plan as tokens at $0 cash.

decided_from_folds.description: The other two folds, whose pooled held-out scores decided this fold.

chosen_arm.description: The chosen arm's arm_id, or 'parent' when the parent is kept.

gain_lfo.description: The leave-fold-out primary gain over the fold's parent.

guard_ok.description: No other primary stratum's leave-fold-out point falls by more than 0.01.

raw_by_fold.description: The arm's raw primary score on each fold's held-out queries.

control.description: Control arms (rewired, generic, chunk-random, N, the Flash-Lite bank) are never candidates.

bundle_raw.description: The arm's model bundle in bytes; required (non-null) for squeeze arms.

Ship.description: A0: `arcforge ship` writes the flag on arc/main only; the production branch, Cloudflare settings and DNS are never touched.

Mde.description: The R00 values, copied unchanged into every later report.

I1.description: A0 form: I1.pass := I1a and I1b and I1c and I1d. No owner field.

probes.description: I1a: known-answer probes per type (40 drawn per type by HMAC('probe'); a type with n < 20 is reported, not gated).

ref.description: I1b: the three-family reference (claude-opus-5-5, OLMo-2-1124-13B-Instruct, phi-4) on 150 pairs (100 D, 50 E); the reference grade is the family median.

kappa_qw_median.description: Quadratic-weighted kappa of the primary against the family median (gated >= 0.6).

kappa_qw_ipw.description: The inverse-probability-weighted population kappa (reported, not gated).

alpha_families.description: Ordinal Krippendorff alpha across the families (gated >= 0.5).

claude_leg_status.description: accepted, or why the Claude leg dropped to the open families (reported).

kendall.description: I1c (unchanged): Kendall tau between judge pairs over the 8 registered systems, with a bootstrap CI and tau-b.

diff.description: I1d: the lineage differential, delta = mean(primary - ref | dense-only) - mean(primary - ref | BM25-only) in grade points, ref = mean(Claude, phi-4) (phi-4 alone if the Claude leg dropped); gated ci_hi <= 0.30.

author_kendall.description: Report-only: Kendall tau of the systems' order under the primary qrels against the order under the corpus's own author links.

author_disagrees_fable.description: Report-only: Fable gold pairs whose grade contradicts the corpus link.

null_fp_rate.description: Report-only: the primary's grade >= 2 rate on null (unrelated) pairs.

pass_effective.description: The latest I1 pass at or before this run.

ref.description: A0: the 150 I1b three-family median pairs plus 150 Fable gold pairs drawn by sha256 (disjoint). Claude appears in both references.

I6.description: A0 rule 3, label reliability for H3: I6.pass := fleiss_kappa >= 0.6 and placebo_rerate - random_rerate <= 0.10. R03, R10/R10K only.

archive_only_flagged.description: Words with fewer than 3 web occurrences, labelled on archive lines only.

expect.description: P1, P5: grade >= 2; P2, P3, P4: grade <= 1.

pass.description: acc >= 0.90 for a gated type; null for an ungated one.

ProxyVault.description: A0 rule 5: the just-in-time proxy vault (renamed from vault). Each registered read is a fresh proxy-reader set generated after a witnessed freeze of the champions and a public beacon; no key exists. Rules read only the rounded registered value before R10.

read_points.description: Run ids of the realized branch's read points.

hybrid_minus_b2_ndcg10.description: The registered value, mean(hyb(champ) - B2) at nDCG@10, rounded to 0.01 (intent-only while I1_pass_effective is false).

sign.description: 'unavailable' exactly when the read is compromised (VJ-7).

basis.description: judged, or intent_only (only the intent record relevant) when I1_pass_effective is false.

compromised.description: Sticky (VJ-7): once set it stays set, and every later sign is 'unavailable'.

reads.description: Every read of the realized path so far, this run's last.

beacon_round.description: The drand quicknet round R_k (or the NIST pulse index).

identity_rate.description: Second-pass identity rate; below 0.95 is reported as non-reproducible but does not void the read.

uri.description: Where the set, pools, grades and per-query scores are published (the host of record).

pool_size.description: Uncapped: every fit's top 100 per ranking, plus 30 random and 30 placebo words.

label.description: 're-meaning lexicon' only while H3 is SUPPORTED.

labelers.description: Three non-Claude families; the registered label is their majority.

contexts.description: Each item is labelled on 3 archive KWIC lines and on 3 FineWeb-Edu KWIC lines (HMAC('kwic')).

proposals_md_sha256.description: null when the optional S13b briefs did not run.

definition.const: 1 − cos(Procrustes(W0), W1) per record, plus 10-NN rewiring

rule_checked.description: Clusters the mechanical person-map rules (1-5) and the quarantine rules (Q1-Q3) decided.

quarantined.description: Clusters quarantined at R00 before any pool was scored (A0 rule 6).

Panel.description: The proxy reader (allenai/OLMo-2-1124-13B base, pinned, fp8 on vLLM, or its registered fallback variant).

variant.description: The variant as realized under the M1 model-choice record.

published.description: c_frontier stays unpublished (sha256 witnessed) until R09.

counts.description: {item_kind: {author_class: n}} from `git blame --line-porcelain` at the S0 commit.

records_hit.description: Records with an exact hit; each leaves every exposure frame.

precutoff.description: The six records first committed before the reader's stated cutoff (Dec. 2023): 18 non-deferrable lookups, or their recorded exclusion from every exposure frame.

continuation.description: The controlled continuation test (prefix 64, generate 32, 20 positive and 20 negative controls); null if it did not run.

ClaudePlanTokens.description: Claude-plan tokens (the Claude reference leg), logged against the owner's plan, $0 cash. R00 cap 0.5M; arc cap 0.8M.

FableCall.description: One orchestrator call: the packet, the accepted output (null unless status is ok), the agent session and model the harness reported, how many attempts were made (a schema-invalid or declined output is retried once in a fresh agent), the repair cycle (A0: the sign-off may be repaired and resubmitted at most twice; a third refusal halts the arc), the sha256 of every refusal (published verbatim), and the final status (null while pending; halted only for the sign-off; missing only for the end review). There is no manual sign.

repair_cycle.description: 0 for the first submission; 1 or 2 after a repair.

lint_ok.description: Sign-off only: whether the linted rules passed.

VerdictsProxyVault.description: The proxy vault's registered aggregate, the only proxy_vault fields a rule may read before R10.

GatesInputs.description: Every number a gate rule reads. I2, I3, I5 and I6 extend the program's list so that every rule's inputs are in verdicts.json (the blind pass reads nothing else).

I1.description: A0: probe_min_acc (I1a, the lowest accuracy over gated probe types), kappa_qw_median and alpha_families (I1b), min_kendall_ci_lo (I1c), delta_ci_hi (I1d).

I1_prior_pass.description: The I1 pass carried forward from the last run that decided it.

GatesSummary.description: Verdicts, all of them: stripped as a whole in the blind pass.

SignoffInputs.description: R00 only: the A0 sign-off preconditions the R00 tail measured.

lint_ok.description: `arcforge prereg lint --frozen` passed, the A0 lint included (no owner field, no reader output in a training or selection input, no per-query proxy_vault before R10, no production traffic).

a0_witness_first.description: A0 is amendments[0] and its sha256 is the earliest entry under configs/witness.pub.

r00_sets_witnessed.description: The r00-sets entry: C_open, frontier and quarantine sha256s.

model_choice_present.description: The M1 model-choice record (load test, pilot yield, chosen variant).

precutoff_lookups_resolved.description: The 18 lookups for the six pre-cutoff records landed, or those records are out of every exposure frame with the exclusion recorded (non-deferrable).

i1_fallback_scheduled.description: PREREG-A1 registered and the r01 plan carries the re-judge line.

registered.description: false for H1.c2 and H1.c4 while I1_pass_effective is false, and for exploratory rows.

ci_lo_raw.description: 95%; two-way pigeonhole bootstrap (10k) on seed-averaged per-query scores; ratio rows: record-clustered bootstrap; P@100 rows: 5-refit x 2,000-item pooled bootstrap.

holm_rank.description: 1..m inside the family; 0 for rows outside it.

seed_sd.description: SD over seeds (over refits for P@100) of the per-seed point estimate; 0 for deterministic systems.

nested.description: True when scores are held-out-fold scores under fold-wise champions.

proxy_vault_read.description: True for a row scored on a proxy-vault set (R10/R10K's C_vault).

AdoptionDecisionCore.description: The inputs of one fold's adoption decision, and its outcome (chosen_arm, adopted).

hypotheses.description: Every rule in rules.yaml exactly once.

adoption.description: The adoption decisions of this run (null when none).

VerdictsDocBlind.description: verdicts.json as Fable's blind pass receives it: every status, verdict component, prediction_met, the whole gates_summary, arc_summary[].final_status and the adoption outcomes stripped; everything the rules read kept.
